{{Quote|I'm Sergeant Molcarrus, Third Recon Company. Are you here about the bounty on the jungle predators?|Molcarrus|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Molcarrus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Third Recon Company]] of the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Stationed on the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], Molcarrus' unit was sent into the [[Riverfall Wilds]] to protect the Empire's [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] from jungle predators, and he assumed command after his superior was killed by one. He requested assistance from [[Kaas City]], but the Empire only instituted a bounty on the jungle creatures.<ref name="TOR" />
